root_idea.summary: The root's lexicon preserves three distinct branches: edible cheese, cowardice or weak-heartedness, and the side areas of the forehead.
root_idea.development: These branches are treated as separate lexical formations rather than as developments from one single measurable principle; derived forms extend them into cheese-making, cowardice judgments, descriptive epithets, and place terms.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression لِلْجَبِينِ in 37:103, it denotes a lateral part of the forehead; the dual جبينان refers to the two sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become cowardly or weak-hearted; to hold back from someone or something through cowardice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The second construction takes عَنْ with the person or thing from which one refrains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cowardly or weak-hearted, as an adjectival epithet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported adjectival use distinct from the anatomical noun meaning “side of the forehead.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attribute cowardice to someone or accuse someone of being a coward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related passive construction describes someone as being accused of cowardice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To find or deem someone cowardly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb takes the person judged to be a coward as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For milk to become like cheese or coagulate into cheese.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of milk undergoing the change into cheese.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become thick, gross, coarse, or big.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative or extended usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make cheese from milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the milk from which cheese is made.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cheese, an edible food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may take a singulative form for a piece, round, or loaf of cheese.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cowardice or weak-heartedness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun used substantivally for the quality of being cowardly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of cheese.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational relational form derived from جُبْنٌ meaning cheese.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A coward or a cowardly, weak-hearted person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet for a person who habitually dreads things and does not venture boldly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extremely generous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiom, explained by the idea that continual visits from guests keep the person's dog from growling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mild or gentle in outward manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in the figurative contrast شُجَاعُ الْقَلْبِ جَبَانُ الْوَجْهِ, “courageous in heart, mild in face”; this interpretation is presented tentatively in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The forehead generally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader classical anatomical use in addition to the more specific sense of a side of the forehead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who keeps or guards the produce of land in the desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized occupational or situational use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An open-air or common place of prayer, especially in a desert tract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A prayer ground outside the built-up area.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A burial ground or cemetery.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This use is associated with the customary location of an open-air prayer place; its derivation from this root is disputed in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert tract or open country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A landscape term, not restricted to the prayer-place sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A herb-rich, level, elevated tract of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Descriptions vary as to whether the tract is smooth, wooded, or contains hills; the common feature is level elevated land associated with abundant herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dweller in the desert or open country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational form based on جَبَّانٌ in the sense of desert tract.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of cowardice or weak-heartedness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe something that makes a person more concerned for continued life or property and therefore less daring.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Relational and place-name derivation without an independent lexical branch.

cautions: جَبِينٌ has distinct reported anatomical and adjectival uses: the Quranic form is anatomical, while a separate classical report uses the form for cowardly or weak-hearted.
The burial-ground sense of جَبَّانَةٌ has a disputed etymology in the lexical evidence.
The figurative interpretation of جَبَانُ الْوَجْهِ is explicitly tentative.
